questions.prompt: An Azure Monitor action group's sample email test fails. What can you conclude about a separate metric alert rule's threshold evaluation from this result alone?

options.text: Nothing definitive; the sample tests the action path, not the metric condition.
options.explanation: Investigate delivery separately and check real rule evaluation using its own state and telemetry.

options.text: The metric threshold is definitely false.
options.explanation: Sample delivery does not evaluate the metric threshold.

options.text: The real metric rule definitely fired.
options.explanation: Sending a sample does not establish that the real rule evaluated true.

options.text: The VM definitely stopped emitting metric samples.
options.explanation: A notification-path failure does not prove loss of metric collection.

questions.prompt: A VM has maintenance every Friday from 02:00 to 03:00 UTC. Keep metric-alert evaluation active and suppress action groups only during that recurring hour, including future Fridays. Which processing-rule schedule meets the requirement?

options.text: VM scope; suppress action groups; weekly Friday 02:00–03:00 UTC.
options.explanation: Weekly Friday recurrence covers the repeated maintenance hour without suppressing other days.

options.text: VM scope; suppress action groups; a one-time window for this Friday 02:00–03:00 UTC.
options.explanation: A one-time window does not cover later Fridays.

options.text: VM scope; suppress action groups; weekly Saturday 02:00–03:00 UTC.
options.explanation: The recurring day is wrong, so Friday maintenance is not covered.

options.text: VM scope; suppress action groups; daily 02:00–03:00 UTC.
options.explanation: Daily recurrence suppresses six additional days, contrary to the Friday-only requirement.
